title: Sinusoidal positional encoding extrapolation is only hypothesized
description: The paper hypothesizes that sinusoidal positional encodings may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than those encountered during training, but this is not demonstrated experimentally.
canonical_description: positional encoding extrapolation to unseen sequence lengths is hypothesized but not demonstrated

evidence.anchor: may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than the ones encountered during training
evidence.quote: We chose the sinusoidal version because it may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than the ones encountered during training.
